svg.title: Audit of regenerated locked-threshold H&E predictions
svg.desc: Seven whole-field H&E overlays algorithmically selected without manual image review during this audit, with solid reference, dashed classical, and dotted Hibou-B contours plus a reproducibility legend.

rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;
